# AlphaJournal Support

Use the narrowest channel for the problem.

## Security or privacy

Report exploitable vulnerabilities, leaked credentials, authorization/payment bypasses, cross-user access, or private-data exposure through a [Private Security Advisory](https://github.com/NK2552003/TradeX/security/advisories/new).

Do not place confidential evidence in a public issue.

## Reproducible product or engineering defects

Use the [Issue Form chooser](https://github.com/NK2552003/TradeX/issues/new/choose). The forms cover frontend, auth, database/egress, billing, market data, AI, community/messages, mobile/linking, performance, deployment, features, documentation, and non-sensitive hardening.

Include a sanitized reproduction, affected version/environment, expected and actual behavior, and testable acceptance criteria.

## Contribution and development questions

Read:

- [Contributing Guide](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [Engineering Contract](../AGENTS.md)
- [Issue Guide](ISSUE_GUIDE.md)
- [Security & Release Command Center](../ALPHAJOURNAL_NEXT_STEPS.md)

## Account-specific support

Do not post private account, billing, authentication, or message details publicly. Use the support route published on [alphajournal.in](https://alphajournal.in) when available.

The GitHub issue tracker is not a secure support inbox and maintainers may remove reports that expose credentials or personal data.
